speaker_attribution: Gil Marer expressly adopts the retrospective criminal-first position recorded here. Institutional, third-party and contemporaneous source accounts remain separately attributed.
purpose: Link every person in the finite DP 3205/predecessor-to-Acosta-Matos scope to a sourced act, omission or express no-located-act statement without rewriting contemporaneous evidence through hindsight.

temporal_ledgers.CONTEMPORANEOUS: What a dated source recorded, attributed and disputed at the time.
temporal_ledgers.RETROSPECTIVE: Later evidence and Gil Marer's present reconstruction of continuity, consequence and criminal/prosecutorial significance.
temporal_ledgers.rule: The ledgers are reciprocally linked but never silently merged. Retrospective significance is not inserted into the historic source; historic source status does not erase later corroborative significance.

non_transfer_rule: No co-appearance, family description, corporate office, professional relationship, network edge or chronological succession transfers conduct, knowledge, intent, guilt or liability.
criminal_attribution_rule: Gil alleges that the private-actor authority mechanism was criminal, not merely civil or innocuous, and contributed to later harm. This is a direct party allegation and investigative lens, not an adjudicated finding.
